verdict.rationale: Airwallex natively runs recurring schedules only in billing: recurring invoices and subscriptions that charge different items on different schedules. These are true recurring schedules, not one-off actions. The CLI and AgentOS support scripted and multi-step workflows but document no built-in scheduler, so recurring automation of other jobs would need an external cron or orchestrator. missing for 10: general-purpose scheduling of recurring jobs or workflows (e.g., scheduled transfers or scheduled agent and AgentOS workflows), schedule management via the API, CLI or MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: You can issue invoices in two ways with Airwallex Billing: One-time invoices ... Recurring invoices
Multi-frequency: Charging for different items on different schedules, for example, an annual upfront software fee combined with monthly support fees.
